tasks.description: Create scripts/scs001/diagnose-publish-stall.ts: read workspace/scs001/post-queue.jsonl, count pending/posted/failed entries, list top 5 pending video titles, check if TIKTOK_ACCESS_TOKEN is set, print stall reason to console, then send a compact Telegram message to OWNER_TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID via TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN summarising the queue state. Use node fetch or https module (no external npm deps). Standalone script, runs via npx ts-node.
